import { defineTable, col, rel, pgEnum } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { diaryEntries } from "./diary_entries";
import { users } from "./users";

const formatEnum = pgEnum("format_enum", ["html", "markdown", "text"]);

export const diaryComments = defineTable("diary_comments", {
    columns: {
        id: col.bigserial({ mode: "number" }).primaryKey(),
        diaryEntryId: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }).notNull(),
        userId: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }).notNull(),
        body: col.text().notNull(),
        createdAt: col.custom({ dataType: "timestamp without time zone" }).notNull(),
        updatedAt: col.custom({ dataType: "timestamp without time zone" }).notNull(),
        visible: col.boolean().notNull().default(true),
        bodyFormat: formatEnum().notNull().default("markdown")
    },
    relations: {
        diaryEntry: rel.belongsTo(() => diaryEntries, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        user: rel.belongsTo(() => users, { onDelete: "no action" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
